name: 图像与视频生成
description: Two-step studio: prompt + face/outfit/pose references -> /v1/images/edits or /v1/images/generations, then the generated image + a video prompt -> the async /v1/videos job (Ref2VA). One shared size-pair table binds step 1's image canvas to an aspect-ratio-matched step 2 video canvas; optional unpaired video sizes are marked explicitly. A quick-verify pair sets both canvases to 256x256 with the shortest clip (4s) and 4 steps so a clip renders in minutes on this machine. Staged progress, inline preview/playback and PNG/MP4 download.
storage: server sqlite via /v1/apps/imagegen/state (image + video history), localStorage:cwick.imagegen.v2 fallback
